description: This file defines an interface class 'CacCapabilities' for querying CAC (Channel Access Control) capabilities of an agent, including methods for retrieving country code, supported radios, supported CAC methods, duration for CAC, and operating classes and channels. It also includes utility functions related to CAC capabilities.

classes.name: CacCapabilities
classes.description: An interface class for querying CAC capabilities of an agent, with methods to retrieve country code, supported radios, supported CAC methods, CAC duration, and operating classes.

methods.name: get_country_code
methods.description: Returns the ISO 3166 country code of the agent.

methods.name: get_cac_radios
methods.description: Returns a vector of MAC addresses for radios that can perform CAC.

methods.name: is_cac_method_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific CAC method is supported on a given radio.

methods.name: get_cac_completion_duration
methods.description: Returns the duration in seconds for CAC scan on a radio using a specific method.

methods.name: get_cac_operating_classes
methods.description: Provides a map of operating classes to channels for a given radio and CAC method.
